title: Text: DET Jay Sartori ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: If you hear anything about the Nationals now or during the winter meetings, please let me know

There likely will be an opening covering them and I’m going for it. I’m not going to just throw shit at the wall, but I know people with them so a heads up to try and track something down would be helpful
